bit_order: bit 0 at the rightmost character (QX); b = measure q puts q[k] on bit k
role: which reset map the hosted QX emulator applies: the cQASM measure-and-flip, which keeps the register's relative phases, or qxelarator 0.10.0's sqrt(|a0|^2 + |a1|^2) map, which drops them

preregistered.falsifier: reset_phase reading 10 in every shot refutes the qxelarator map on the hosted emulator, and 00 in every shot refutes the cQASM map; one shot of control_x or already_zero off 10 refutes the program or the register order
